# 2 Samuel Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 170v–172r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_003_page_001.jpg, 2SA_003_page_002.jpg, 2SA_003_page_003.jpg

---

**3:1** And-was the-war long between [the]-house of-Sha'ul and-between [the]-house of-David; and-David [was]-going and-growing-strong, and-[the]-house of-Sha'ul [were]-going and-becoming-weak.

**3:2** And-were-born to-David sons in-Chevron; and-was his-firstborn Amnon, of-Achinoam the-Yizre'elitess.

**3:3** And-his-second [was] Kil'av, of-Avigayil wife of-Naval the-Karmelite; and-the-third [was] Avshalom son of-Ma'akhah daughter of-Talmai king of-Geshur.

**3:4** And-the-fourth [was] Adoniyah son of-Chaggit; and-the-fifth [was] Shefatyah son of-Avital.

**3:5** And-the-sixth [was] Yitre'am, of-Eglah wife of-David. These were-born to-David in-Chevron.

**3:6** And-it-was while-there-was war between [the]-house of-Sha'ul and-between [the]-house of-David, and-Avner was making-himself-strong in-[the]-house of-Sha'ul.

**3:7** And-to-Sha'ul [was] a-concubine [pilegesh], and-her-name [was] Ritspah daughter of-Ayyah. And-he-said [Ish-Boshet] to Avner, "Why did-you-go-in to the-concubine of-my-father?"

**3:8** And-it-burned to-Avner exceedingly upon [the]-words of-Ish-Boshet, and-he-said, "A-head of-a-dog [am]-I, which [belongs] to-Yehudah? Today I-do covenant-faithfulness [hesed] with-[the]-house of-Sha'ul your-father, to his-brothers and-to his-friends, and-not I-delivered-you into-[the]-hand of-David; and-you-charge upon-me a-guilt of-the-woman today?

**3:9** So may-God-do to-Avner and-so may-He-add to-him, if-not as-that-which YHWH swore to-David, so I-will-do for-him:

**3:10** to-transfer the-kingdom from-[the]-house of-Sha'ul, and-to-raise-up [the]-throne of-David over Yisra'el and-over Yehudah, from-Dan and-unto Be'er-Sheva."

**3:11** And-not he-was-able again to-return Avner a-word, from his-fearing him.

**3:12** And-sent Avner messengers to David in-his-place [i.e., on his behalf], saying, "To-whom [belongs] the-land?" Saying, "Cut [karot] your-covenant [berit] with-me, and-behold, my-hand [is] with-you, to-turn to-you all Yisra'el."

**3:13** And-he-said, "Good; I will-cut with-you a-covenant. Only one thing I [am]-asking from-you, saying: you-shall-not see my-face unless first you-bring Mikhal daughter of-Sha'ul when-you-come to-see my-face."

**3:14** And-sent David messengers to Ish-Boshet son of-Sha'ul, saying, "Give [back] my-wife Mikhal, whom I-betrothed to-myself for-a-hundred foreskins of-[the]-Pelishtim."

**3:15** And-sent Ish-Boshet and-took-her from-with a-husband, from-with Palti'el son of-Layish.

**3:16** And-went her-husband with-her, going and-weeping after-her, unto Bachurim. And-said Avner to-him, "Go, return." And-he-returned.

**3:17** And-[the]-word of-Avner was with [the]-elders of-Yisra'el, saying, "Both yesterday and-the-day-before [i.e., previously] you-were seeking David as-king over-you.

**3:18** And-now, do [it], for YHWH has-said to David, saying, 'By-[the]-hand of-my-servant David I-will-save my-people Yisra'el from-[the]-hand of-[the]-Pelishtim and-from-[the]-hand of-all their-enemies.'"

**3:19** And-spoke Avner also in-[the]-ears of-Binyamin. And-went also Avner to-speak in-[the]-ears of-David in-Chevron all that [was]-good in-[the]-eyes of-Yisra'el and-in-[the]-eyes of-all [the]-house of-Binyamin.

**3:20** And-came Avner to David to-Chevron, and-with-him twenty men. And-made David for-Avner and-for-the-men who [were] with-him a-feast [mishteh].

**3:21** And-said Avner to David, "Let-me-arise and-go, and-I-will-gather to my-lord the-king all Yisra'el, and-they-will-cut with-you a-covenant, and-you-will-reign over all that your-soul [nephesh] desires." And-sent-away David Avner, and-he-went in-peace.

**3:22** And-behold, [the]-servants of-David and-Yo'av came from the-raid, and-plunder great they-brought with-them. And-Avner was-not with David in-Chevron, for he-had-sent-him-away and-he-had-gone in-peace.

**3:23** And-Yo'av and-all the-army that [was] with-him came, and-they-told to-Yo'av, saying, "Avner son of-Ner came to the-king, and-he-sent-him-away and-he-went in-peace."

**3:24** And-came Yo'av to the-king and-said, "What have-you-done? Behold, Avner came to-you — why then did-you-send-him-away and-he-went, going away [halokh halakh]?

**3:25** You-know Avner son of-Ner — that to-deceive-you he-came, and-to-know your-going-out and-your-coming-in, and-to-know all that you [are]-doing."

**3:26** And-went-out Yo'av from-with David and-sent messengers after Avner, and-they-brought-him-back from-[the]-cistern of-Sirah; and-David did-not know.

**3:27** And-returned Avner to Chevron, and-turned-him-aside Yo'av to-[the]-midst of-the-gate to-speak with-him in-quietness [ba-sheli]. And-he-struck-him there the-belly [chomesh], and-he-died, for-[the]-blood of-Asa'el his-brother.

**3:28** And-heard David from-after-this and-said, "Innocent [am]-I and-my-kingdom from-with YHWH forever, from-[the]-blood of-Avner son of-Ner.

**3:29** Let-it-whirl upon-[the]-head of-Yo'av and-upon all [the]-house of-his-father, and-let-there-not be-cut-off from-[the]-house of-Yo'av one-having-a-discharge [zav] or-a-leper [metsora] or-one-who-holds the-spindle [pelek] or-one-who-falls by-the-sword or-one-lacking bread."

**3:30** And-Yo'av and-Avishai his-brother killed Avner, because he-had-killed Asa'el their-brother in-Giv'on in-the-battle.

**3:31** And-said David to Yo'av and-to all the-people who [were] with-him, "Tear your-garments and-gird sackcloth and-mourn before Avner." And-the-king David [was]-walking after the-bier.

**3:32** And-they-buried Avner in-Chevron, and-lifted-up the-king his-voice and-wept at-[the]-tomb of-Avner, and-wept all the-people.

**3:33** And-lamented the-king over Avner and-said,
"As-[the]-death of-a-fool [naval], should-Avner die?

**3:34** Your-hands were-not bound,
and-your-feet were-not brought-near to-chains [nechushta'im].
As-one-falls before sons of-wickedness [bney-avlah], you-fell."
And-all the-people added again to-weep over-him.

**3:35** And-came all the-people to-give-David-bread to-eat while-yet the-day [lasted], and-swore David, saying, "So may-God-do to-me and-so may-He-add, if before the-sun goes-down I-taste bread or-anything."

**3:36** And-all the-people recognized [it], and-it-was-good in-their-eyes; all that the-king did [was]-good in-[the]-eyes of-all the-people.

**3:37** And-knew all the-people and-all Yisra'el on-that day that not it-was from the-king to-kill Avner son of-Ner.

**3:38** And-said the-king to his-servants, "Do-you-not know that a-prince [sar] and-a-great-one has-fallen this-day in-Yisra'el?

**3:39** And-I today [am]-tender and-anointed king, and-these men, [the]-sons of-Tseruyah, [are]-too-hard for-me. May-YHWH-repay the-doer of-evil according-to his-evil."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.8 — "head of a dog":** The expression *rosh kelev* is a self-deprecating insult — Abner feels treated like something contemptible. The phrase intensifies the political rupture.

**v.27 — ba-sheli:** The adverb means "in quietness/secrecy." Joab takes Abner aside privately — ostensibly for a private word — then strikes him in the same *chomesh* (belly) where Abner killed Asahel (2:23). The narrative symmetry is deliberate.

**v.29 — pelek:** The "spindle" holder is debated. Some read it as "one who leans on a crutch" (i.e., a cripple); others take it literally as "one who works the spindle" (i.e., reduced to women's work). David's curse encompasses disease, disability, violent death, and poverty.

**v.33 — naval:** The word for "fool" (*naval*) is a pointed double-meaning — it is also the name of Abigail's first husband (1 Sam 25). David asks whether Abner died the death of a *naval*, a senseless, dishonorable death.

*— EMET*
